questions.prompt: What makes anthropology's approach to the self holistic?

options.text: It studies only ancient objects
It connects human life to culture, relationships, language, history, biology, and environment

questions.explanation: A holistic approach connects several dimensions of human life rather than isolating one trait or artifact. It also requires attention to participants' meanings and historical context.

questions.prompt: What is enculturation?
